text:
Maria Li: FYI I just opened a PR for the 0.9.5 changelog and release notes — lightweight draft with feature bullets and one known-issue we should call out. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4023 :wave:

Kevin Patel: on it. what's the known issue? severity/impact?

Maria Li: repro on internal e2e: embeddings streaming can yield truncated context when requests hit the KV cache boundary during concurrent batches. Low frequency but customer-impacting for long-prefix workloads.

Olivia Gomez: hmm ok. we should be explicit with the workaround. do we have a concise user-facing line + an ops note?

Maria Li: proposed user-facing blurb: "Known issue: streaming embeddings with long prefix + KV cache may occasionally truncate the returned vector. Workaround: disable streaming for embeddings or use the non-streaming embeddings endpoint." ops note (for release notes details): "Patch: disabled streaming by default for embeddings endpoints on Dedicated until upstream kernel fix; customers may opt-in."

Prashant Rao: can we add the snippet for the SDK change? small code example helps.

Maria Li: yes — adding one in the PR. snippet below — please sanity check: 
```js
// JS SDK: force non-streaming embeddings
const r = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'rwd-embed-large',
  input: '...long document...',
  streaming: false, // ensure full vector returned
});
```

Kevin Patel: LGTM. also add a short migration note for anyone who relied on streaming semantics for early cancellation. maybe an entry in migration.md.

Olivia Gomez: wording suggestion for the changelog paragraph: "Temporary change: embeddings streaming disabled for affected configurations. If you rely on early partial results, see migration guide for alternative batching patterns and explicit cancellation flows." shorter and fits the 1–2 line requirement.

Jen H.: I can do the link sweep and SDK snippet placement in the docs tree tomorrow. any specific pages to update besides the embeddings API page?

Maria Li: thanks Jen — update: embeddings API reference, SDK examples page, and the migration guide under /guides/migration/embedding-changes.md. Also add a small note on the release notes page (changelog entry) with a link to the migration guide.

Prashant Rao: quick nit on the snippet — our JS SDK example usually uses `client.embeddings.create` but we should show the top-level import so copy/paste works: 
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const r = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-large', input: '...', streaming: false });
```

Maria Li: perfect — I'll push that variant.

Docs Bot: Pull request opened: #4023 — "changelog: 0.9.5 release notes + embeddings known issue" (assignee: Maria Li) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4023

Kevin Patel: can we also include a short regression test note? e.g., add an integration test that checks embeddings shape/length against input set when streaming disabled.

Olivia Gomez: yes, add a QA checklist item in the PR description: "verify embeddings vector stability for long-prefix inputs (x10 randomized)". I'll add that.

Jen H.: I'll queue a docs PR for the snippet placement and link fixes once #4023 merges. assign me and I'll do the sweep. :white_check_mark: 

Maria Li: thanks everyone. final ask: two approvals on the changelog wording and the migration link. tagging for visibility: @Kevin Patel @Olivia Gomez — please approve on PR if wording is fine.

Kevin Patel: approving now.

Olivia Gomez: approving. go ahead and merge when CI passes. :rocket:
